message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on Halloween costume accessory sets. Festive articles fall under heading 9505, and the sets would be classified as festive articles, specifically 9505.90.6000 ("Other" festive, carnival or other entertainment articles, other than those for Christmas).

Costume wearing apparel for Halloween would be excluded from heading 9505 only if it is a textile article of chapters 61 or 62. Note 1(e) to chapter 95 excludes sports clothing and fancy dress of textiles in chapters 61 or 62. Here, the sets are accessories (ears, tail, collar, hat, cuffs) and are not made-up apparel of those chapters. Classification as festive articles in 9505 is therefore appropriate.

Within 9505.90, the subheadings are 9505.90.20 (Christmas ornaments, not relevant), 9505.90.40 (Christmas articles other than ornaments), and 9505.90.60 (Other). The statistical suffix for 9505.90.60 is 00.

The set is not a Christmas article, so 9505.90.6000 applies.
